key_insight: In this ALS biomarker study—not AI cancer drug discovery—circulating gelsolin declined with advancing disease stage across four cohorts, distinguishing disease position from progression rate.
clinical_relevance: Gelsolin could complement neurofilament light chain in research on prognosis and trial stratification by capturing a different dimension of ALS progression.
method: Profiled 5,401 serum proteins and 1,659 plasma and cerebrospinal fluid metabolites in 94 ALS patients and 39 controls in Sheffield.
Defined disease stage as the fraction of the onset-to-death interval elapsed at sampling.
Replicated findings in Tel Aviv, Oxford and US AnswerALS cohorts.
evidence_signal: Gelsolin tracked stage across all four cohorts and explained 7–10% of between-patient stage variance using survival-based staging and 19% using functional-decline-based staging.
watch_item: Survival-based staging depends on knowing eventual survival, so prospective usefulness and clinical implementation require further validation.
paper_title: Circulating gelsolin tracks disease stage in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis across four cohorts
